summary: detectPartialFailure (helpers.go) also calls detectGraphQLFailure: a non-empty top-level GraphQL errors array, or a data.<field>.__typename ending in Error/ErrorResponse (CheckoutRedirectError, CheckoutCheckoutErrorResponse, ...), makes the command report success:false and exit non-zero. Verify synthetic responses are skipped. order tip reports updated:false and exits non-zero on the same failures.
reason: Generated commands printed GraphQL errors (or an error result type) with success:true and exit 0 because only partialFailureError was checked, so agents treated failed checkout calls as successes.
